headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Darby Allin vs. Tommaso Ciampa went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.13 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. In his very first title defense, a battered Allin locked in the Scorpion Deathlock to make Ciampa tap, with the two men embracing afterward as Ciampa put the new champion over.
Turning the clock back to 2020: AEW welcomed Alan Angels for the first time against Kenny Omega, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.38.
Back on this day in 2022, Marina Shafir made a statement, debuting in the main event against Jade Cargill, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.13.

secondaries.text: 2020 brought us this moment: Orange Cassidy returned to the fold after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On this day in 2020, Dustin Rhodes vs. Kip Sabian met in a Tournament Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 5.77.
Looking back to 2026, when Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.36.
